confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and the supplied context; no live menus, booking pages or current listings were checked. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation is least certain because summer rates are volatile. Anchors assume roughly 150 to 155 yen per US dollar, an estimated level rather than a looked-up rate. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the typical Japanese price relationship to draft beer, as direct knowledge is weaker.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink priced in line with other major Japanese tourist cities such as Osaka and Tokyo; accommodation adjusted for Kyoto's limited hotel supply and strong tourist demand in summer.
